difficulty_reason: The lemma describes curves without rational tails in each genus (statement lines 6080-6093). The proof (lines 6095-6130) is a complete three-case chain: Gorenstein input, the genus-0 dichotomy (tail contradiction versus conic classification), the genus-1 vanishing of componentwise degrees with the duality conclusion, and the genus->=2 case combining the irreducible lemma with an explicit re-analysis of the two Y = X inequalities in the global-generation proof, which the author states in full. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: systematic case analysis with correctly ordered reference hinges.
